profile.name: Olivia Grant
profile.summary: ACCA-qualified finance professional with 7 years in manufacturing FP&A. Known for clear commentary and tidy models.

descriptions: Produced monthly management accounts and group reporting packs under IFRS for 5 entities
Owned budgeting and rolling forecast for the Europe division (revenue 120m GBP)
Delivered variance analysis versus budget and prior year; presented drivers to plant managers
Built three-statement and capex financial models in Excel, with scenario toggles
Led month-end close tasks in SAP FI/CO: accruals, intercompany reconciliations, bank rec
Prepared audit schedules for the external auditors; zero material findings in 3 years
Developed Power BI dashboards for cost centre owners
Mentored two junior analysts and ran monthly finance reviews with the CFO
Maintained fixed asset register and ledger reconciliations
Supported VAT returns and statutory accounts
IFRS, SAP FI/CO, Advanced Excel, Power BI, Hyperion, Financial modelling
